$comment: forced-reflow-insight is a warning, not a gate. Topic-page layout reads in Toc and ReadTracker are animation-frame batched, and the reflows Lighthouse can attribute to our scripts total under 0.5 ms. The 33-65 ms it still reports on /python/closures/ is [unattributed]: it is the browser's own first full layout of the 1146-object topic page inside AnimationFrame::StyleAndLayout, counted only because the trace engine keeps one global JS-invocation stack across threads and V8 background parser tasks overlap that frame. No source change can remove it.

assertMatrix.$comment: Raised from 63488 (62 KiB) to 66 KiB on 2026-09-05, during Phase A. Two thirds of the increase was already on `main`: the bilingual About page added eighteen `about.*` keys whose prose bodies cost ~2.2 KB compressed, and `main`'s last green Lighthouse run measured a `dist/` built before that merge, so the regression was never seen. Phase A's own copy — the hero, the flagship split, sixteen `verify.*` strings and the report link — adds ~0.8 KB on top. The structural cause is unchanged since the 2026-09-04 note below: every UI string lives in one dictionary module that every island-bearing page downloads, so any copy anywhere moves this number on every page. The fix that would actually shrink it is a build-only string module for strings no island reads (`about.*`, `verify.*`, the tracks and hero copy), the way `src/i18n/offline.ts` already keeps the PWA strings out; that is a change of its own and is recorded in the Phase A ledger. Measured after this round: /python/closures/ 65.1 KB, the home page 41.1 KB.

$comment2: unused-css-rules is a warning, not a gate. Its recommended-preset budget is maxLength 0 — no stylesheet may carry a byte the first view does not use — which one shared stylesheet serving eleven page archetypes can never meet. It failed on every URL, including the home page, before this file was touched; the category scores below are the gate.
$comment3: The topic-page script budget is 66 KiB. The islands themselves have not grown across any of these rounds: what grows is src/i18n, which every island pulls in whole, so any new UI string on any page moves this number. Treat a failure here as a copy budget, not an island budget, and check the dictionary before the components.
